questions.question: What sequence defines T1 in the current standard?
questions.answerText: Natural aging after cooling from elevated-temperature shaping
questions.explanation: T1 is cooled from an elevated-temperature shaping process and naturally aged.

questions.question: What extra step is added to T2 before natural aging?
questions.explanation: T2 adds cold work before natural aging after cooling from elevated-temperature shaping.

questions.question: What three steps define T3?
questions.answerText: Solution heat treated, cold worked, and naturally aged
questions.explanation: T3 is solution heat treated, cold worked, and naturally aged.

questions.question: What two steps define T4?
questions.answerText: Solution heat treated and naturally aged
questions.explanation: T4 is solution heat treated and naturally aged, without the cold work in T3.

questions.question: What sequence defines T5, which does not use solution heat treatment?
questions.answerText: Cooled from elevated-temperature shaping and artificially aged
questions.explanation: T5 is cooled from an elevated-temperature shaping process and artificially aged, without solution treatment.

questions.question: What two treatments define T6?
questions.answerText: Solution heat treated and artificially aged
questions.explanation: T6 is solution heat treated and artificially aged.

questions.question: What defines T7 after solution heat treatment?
questions.explanation: T7 is solution heat treated and artificially overaged.

questions.question: In T8, does cold work happen before or after artificial aging?
questions.explanation: T8 is solution heat treated, cold worked, and then artificially aged.

questions.question: In T9, does cold work happen before or after artificial aging?
questions.explanation: T9 is solution heat treated and artificially aged before cold work.

questions.question: What steps are added to cooled elevated-temperature shaping to make T10?
questions.explanation: T10 is cooled from elevated-temperature shaping, cold worked, and artificially aged.
